session: Homepage shows the latest posts again
text: The homepage post list is hand-maintained in content/site.json, so the live site showed stale posts until someone noticed and hotfixed it by hand.

session: Backfill posts that aged out of the Substack feed
text: Older Substack posts silently vanished from the site once they aged out of the RSS feed; the author only noticed because posts were missing from the Writing page.

session: New posts reach the homepage and sitemap on their own
text: New Substack posts only appeared on the homepage after someone visited /writing, and the sitemap stayed frozen at deploy time, so the site owner had to redeploy or browse the archive to get new posts listed.

The new essay links point at /writing/<slug> pages that only exist on this unmerged branch, so they could not be clicked through in the local preview (sample posts in the preview database) or on the live site until the branch deploys.
